chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 0591 – The Five Treasure Peaks – Ji Ning Judges a Proud Prince
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning’s world tour ends as he faces a vengeful prince, earns the respect of a wild True Immortal, and arrives at the crushing pressure of the Five Treasure Peaks. Justice is served.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0591 – The Price of Arrogance and the Weight of Peaks
og_description: Ji Ning spares a prince with a three-hundred-year sentence to grind away his arrogance, then stands before the legendary Five Treasure Peaks.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0591 – Tavern Waiter or Oblivion? A Prince’s Choice
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s cold, surgical judgment turns a royal brat into a mortal waiter for 300 years. Then the mountain peaks crush the sky.

lore_anchors.definition: A Celestial Immortal known for his wild, uninhibited, and shameless personality. He is famous in the Three Realms for this nature and is a senior figure in the Sword Sect.
A catastrophic-scale war fought between the forces of the Nuwa and Seamless alliances across multiple realmverses, involving billions of immortals and gods.
The number one sword art in the Three Realms, created by Daofather Fuju. It is a complete, legendary technique containing countless profound mysteries of the sword.
Five towering mountains in the Sword Immortal World, each home to a part of the complete Five Treasures Sword Art. They emanate a crushing spiritual pressure that tests the Dao-heart.
A binding oath that leverages the cosmic retribution mechanism of the Heavenly Dao; breaking it invites tribulation or karmic punishment.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning spare Prince Dongji?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning saw the prince had no true murderous intent. He judged the prince’s character as salvageable and imposed a three-hundred-year mortal trial to finally grind away his arrogance—a punishment as much for the soul as for the crime.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Wuyou True Immortal really that shameless, or is he playing a role?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is his genuine personality. In high-tier Xianxia culture, a powerful cultivator who is openly “shameless” often signals supreme confidence. His offer to kill his own disciple was a blunt, pragmatic sign of respect for Ji Ning’s status.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Five Treasure Peaks make Nine-Fang Heavenly God turn pale?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Peaks exude the residual Dao-pressure of their creator, Daofather Fuju. Resisting this pressure tests the Dao-heart, not just cultivation base. Nine-Fang is a new Heavenly God with a relatively untested spirit, so he struggled.
